intro: Rockstar has named two playable leads and a supporting cast so far. Profiles below are written from Rockstar's official character bios, published with Trailer 2 on 6 May 2025. Expect much more once the game is out.

sources.title: Rockstar Games – Grand Theft Auto VI official site
Gematsu – Trailer 2, characters and places detailed (reproduces Rockstar's bios)

items.name: Jason Duval
items.summary: Ex-Army, now doing jobs for drug runners down in the Keys.
bio: Jason grew up surrounded by small-time crooks and later served in the Army.
He now works for drug runners in the Leonida Keys. Brian Heder lets him live at one of his properties for free, as long as Jason helps out with local shakedowns.
His relationship with Lucia is the centre of the story, and you can switch between the two of them during play.

items.name: Lucia Caminos
items.summary: Just out of Leonida Penitentiary and determined not to go back.
bio: Lucia ended up in Leonida Penitentiary after fighting to protect her family. The game opens with her newly released.
She wants the life her mother hoped for when the family lived in Liberty City, and she sees a future with Jason as her way to get it.
She is the second playable lead, and the Extended Look showed you can swap between her and Jason at any time.

items.name: Cal Hampton
items.summary: Stays home, listens in on the Coast Guard, trusts nobody.
bio: Cal is one of Jason's closest friends and, like him, works with Brian Heder.
He spends most of his time at home monitoring Coast Guard radio traffic and has strong conspiracy-minded views.
Unlike Jason, he is perfectly happy where he is.

items.name: Brian Heder
items.summary: Runs a boat yard in the Keys and gives Jason a roof, for a price.
bio: Brian has been running drugs since the Keys' old smuggling days and never really stopped.
He runs a boat yard with his third wife, Lori, and lets Jason stay at one of his properties in return for help with shakedowns.

items.name: Lori Heder
items.summary: Co-runs the boat yard. Famous locally for her sangria.
bio: Lori is Brian's third wife and helps him run the boat yard in the Keys.
Rockstar singles out one detail about her: her sangria.

items.name: Boobie Ike
items.summary: Turned street money into real estate, a strip club and a studio.
bio: Boobie built a business empire in Vice City out of money made on the street: property, a strip club and a recording studio.
He co-runs the label Only Raw Records with Dre'Quan Priest. The Extended Look opens with Jason and Lucia picking up a shipment tied to him.

items.name: Dre'Quan Priest
items.summary: Former street dealer chasing a name in Vice City's music scene.
bio: Dre'Quan sold on the street before deciding he wanted to run a record label instead.
He co-runs Only Raw Records with Boobie Ike and signed the rap duo Real Dimez.

items.name: Real Dimez
items.summary: School friends with a social following, hunting a second hit.
bio: Bae-Luxe and Roxy have been friends since high school and make rap music while building a following on social media.
They had an early hit on a track with DWNPLY and are now signed to Only Raw Records, trying to land the next one.

items.name: Raul Bautista
items.summary: Veteran robber who recruits people for big, risky scores.
bio: Raul is an experienced, charming and reckless bank robber who is always looking for people willing to take big risks.
With each job the stakes get higher, and anyone on his crew has to decide whether to go all in or walk away.
